# Pagination
Atlas Pagination v1 — page navigation for a long list or table: Previous, numbered pages with ellipsis, and Next. 2 sizes (sm, md); the Position (start, middle, end) is drawn from the current page and is not a prop.

USE WHEN
· A table or result list is split into pages and the user can jump to a page.
· The total number of pages is known.
· Users return to a specific page (compare, share, resume).
DON'T USE WHEN
· The list grows in place as the user asks for more → compose a Load more Button; there is no component for it yet.
· The list is short enough to show every row → no pagination.
· A fixed-order flow of steps → not Pagination.
· The total is unknown or endless → load more or infinite scroll, not numbered pages.
HOW TO USE
· Pass page (1-based), pageCount and onPageChange; the component derives the Position, the ellipses and the disabled ends.
· At most seven slots show: the first and last page, the current page, its neighbours and ellipses; siblingCount (default 1) widens the window.
· The current page is the outline Button with aria-current="page"; Previous and Next are a ghost Button with a chevron, disabled at the ends (in Figma the chevron is a 16 px icon beside a text-only Button, because a swapped icon inside a Button instance cannot be resized).
· Place it below the list, aligned to the end, with a "Showing 21 to 40 of 240" line beside it when the total matters.
· On a phone use size sm and show only the chevrons for Previous and Next.
· In Figma edit the numbers in the nested Buttons; each variant is fixed to one Position.
DO
· Keep the page size constant while paginating.
· Return focus to the top of the list when the page changes.
DON'T
· Use more than one pagination for the same list.
· Show the current page by colour alone.
RELATED
· Button — the page controls are Buttons.
· Table — the usual list to paginate.
· Breadcrumb — navigation between levels, not between pages.

PROPERTIES
Size: sm | md. Position: start | middle | end (derived from the current page).

CODE    <Pagination> in @atlas/ui-web/patterns/Pagination
